title: PBa-LLM: Privacy- and Bias-aware NLP using Named-Entity Recognition (NER)
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The focus is on privacy preservation and gender bias in a recruitment context.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
